{{Quote|Remember Soid Einray?''"<br />"''Soid Einray was a defective already.''"<br />"''Maybe, but he still hung himself afterward.|Hartwig and Kindra discuss Einray's death|<ref name="Red Harvest" />}}
'''Soid Einray''' was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]]<ref name="Red Harvest" /> who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Empire" /> around [[3645 BBY]]. Einray was a student at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]], where he and his classmates learned under the direction of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]]. While he was in attendance at the [[Sith academy|academy]], Scabrous released [[unakki eye spider]]s on the school grounds as a test to cull the weak from his ranks. Eleven students, including Einray, were blinded by the [[Spider/Legends|spiders]]' attacks. After the incident, Einray [[Death/Legends|hung himself]]. He was described as being "a defective" by his classmate [[Kindra]]. The injuries he received from the unakki eye spiders ultimately drove him to commit suicide.<ref name="Red Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soid Einray was mentioned in [[Joe Schreiber]]'s [[2010]] novel, [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
